builtin.cd.curpath.reason: Names an intermediate value used only to describe the algorithm, and the standard says so outright: "There is no requirement that curpath be made visible to the application." Every step that manipulates curpath is asserted separately by the builtin.cd.step* rules.

builtin.cd.env-locale.reason: LC_CTYPE only changes 'the interpretation of sequences of bytes of text data as characters ... in arguments' and LC_MESSAGES only 'the format and contents of diagnostic messages', whose wording POSIX leaves unspecified. Observing either needs an installed non-POSIX locale, and every harness case is pinned to LC_ALL=C/LANG=C for determinism.

builtin.cd.env-nlspath.reason: XSI-shaded: 'NLSPATH determines the location of messages objects and message catalogs'. Gated on the XSI option rather than inapplicable. The requirement locates catalogs; dash ships none and emits only built-in English diagnostics, so on this host there is no catalog for NLSPATH to point at and no observable difference to assert. Recorded as conditional so it is not mistaken for a dismissed obligation.

builtin.cd.stdout-undeterminable-pathnam.reason: Explicitly unspecified: "it is unspecified whether nothing is written to the standard output or the value of curpath used in step 10, followed by a <newline>, is written to the standard output". Both outcomes conform, so no assertion can be made about a cd whose absolute pathname cannot be determined.

builtin.cd.step1-no-operand-no-home.reason: With no directory operand and an empty or unset HOME, "the default behavior is implementation-defined". The residual "no further steps shall be taken" has no observable of its own: any implementation-defined default is indistinguishable from having run the remaining steps, since there is no operand for step 5 to search CDPATH with.

builtin.cd.step8-further-simplification.reason: Permissive: "An implementation may further simplify curpath" by removing trailing and redundant <slash> characters. The rule's only normative clause is contingent on that optional simplification producing a null curpath, so an implementation that declines the simplification never reaches it and cannot fail it.

Observing the rest needs an installed non-POSIX locale, and the harness pins LC_ALL=C.
